story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to request clarification from the Event Organiser so that incomplete or unclear event requirements can be resolved

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Coordinator can identify which information requires clarification.
The Event Coordinator can provide a clarification message.

The event stays Under review while the clarification is open; there is no separate Clarification Required status. The open clarification is shown on the event to the Event Organiser and the assigned Event Coordinator.
The clarification request is associated with the relevant event.

test_cases.title: A clarification request is not sent until at least one item is chosen and a message is written
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: `npm run fixtures:spm29` has been run from the project folder (it only touches the 'SPM29 …' events, never anyone else's data).
'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit' is Under review, assigned to Daniel Tan, with no clarification open.
Logged in as Event Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123).
steps: Click 'Review Queue' in the sidebar and open 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit'
Type the message in 'Message to the organiser'
Clear 'Message to the organiser' and type three spaces
test_cases.test_data:
Event: SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit (Under review, coordinator Daniel Tan)
Message at step 4: Please clarify the event.
Message at step 7: three spaces
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: The 'Review request' page opens with three options under 'Your decision': 'Approve — planning can start', 'Reject this request' and 'Ask the organiser for clarification'.
Step 3: A 'What needs clarification' list appears with an unticked checkbox for each of: Purpose, Description, Category, When, Expected attendance, Preferred layout, Accessibility needs, Special requirements, Registration capacity, Facilities, Equipment. Below it are an empty 'Message to the organiser' box and a 'Send request' button.
Step 5: The message 'Choose at least one item that needs clarification.' is shown and nothing is sent: no 'Clarification requested' message appears.
Step 8: The message 'Write a message for the organiser.' is shown under 'Message to the organiser' and nothing is sent.
Step 9: No 'Open clarification' box is shown, and 'Ask the organiser for clarification' is still offered.

test_cases.title: The assigned coordinator sends a clarification request and the event stays Under review with the request shown on it
test_cases.preconditions:
Run `npm run fixtures:spm29` before this case (and again after it): it sends a request on 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit'.
'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit' is Under review, assigned to Daniel Tan, raised by Rachel Ng, with no clarification open.
Logged in as Event Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123).
steps: Click 'Review Queue' in the sidebar and open 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit'
Type the message in 'Message to the organiser'
Log out and log in as Event Organiser Rachel Ng (rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123)
Click 'My Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit'
test_cases.test_data:
Event: SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit
Items: Purpose, When
Message: Is this a dinner or a conference? Which day do you need?
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 6: A green 'Clarification requested' message says the event stays Under review and the organiser can see the request on the event. The status badge at the top still reads 'Under review'. An 'Open clarification' box shows 'Purpose, When', the message 'Is this a dinner or a conference? Which day do you need?' and 'Asked by Daniel Tan' with today's date and time. 'Ask the organiser for clarification' is no longer offered, while 'Approve — planning can start' and 'Reject this request' still are.
Step 7: 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit' is still listed in the Review Queue with the 'Under review' badge.
Step 8: The event page shows the 'Under review' badge and an amber 'Clarification requested' banner with 'Purpose, When', the message and 'Asked by Daniel Tan' with today's date and time.
Step 10: Rachel Ng's event page shows the 'Under review' badge and the same 'Clarification requested' banner with 'Purpose, When', the message and 'Asked by Daniel Tan'.

test_cases.title: The organiser who raised the event sees its open clarification on the event page, and the event is Under review
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: `npm run fixtures:spm29` has been run from the project folder.
'SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum' is Under review, raised by Rachel Ng and assigned to Daniel Tan, with a clarification Daniel Tan opened on 12 Oct 2026, 10:00 about Purpose and When.
Logged in as Event Organiser Rachel Ng (rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123).
steps: Go back to My Events and open 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit'
test_cases.test_data:
Event with an open clarification: SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum
Event without one: SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit
Message: Is this a dinner or a conference? Which day do you need?
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: 'SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum' is listed with the 'Under review' badge; no 'Clarification required' status appears anywhere.
Step 2: The event page shows the 'Under review' badge and an amber 'Clarification requested' banner listing 'Purpose, When', the message 'Is this a dinner or a conference? Which day do you need?' and 'Asked by Daniel Tan on 12 Oct 2026, 10:00'.
Step 3: No 'Clarification requested' banner is shown on 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit'.

test_cases.title: The assigned coordinator sees the open clarification and cannot open a second one, but can still approve or reject
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: `npm run fixtures:spm29` has been run from the project folder.
'SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum' is Under review, assigned to Daniel Tan, with a clarification Daniel Tan opened on 12 Oct 2026, 10:00 about Purpose and When.
Logged in as Event Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123).
steps: Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum'
test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum (Under review, clarification open)
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: The event page shows the 'Under review' badge and an amber 'Clarification requested' banner listing 'Purpose, When', the message 'Is this a dinner or a conference? Which day do you need?' and 'Asked by Daniel Tan on 12 Oct 2026, 10:00'.

'SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum' is assigned to Daniel Tan and has an open clarification.
Logged in as Event Coordinator Priya Raj (priya.raj@connectsphere.com / password123), who is not assigned to it.

test_cases.test_data:

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Written before the code (test-first). The wording below is decided here and matches the CONTRACT comments in the unit tests (src/lib/__tests__/clarification.test.ts, src/app/api/__tests__/clarifications.test.ts, src/app/__tests__/event-pages.test.tsx); change both together if the team wants different wording.

RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Wording on the 'Review request' page - option 'Ask the organiser for clarification' (from design/mockups/EventReview.dc.html); checkbox group 'What needs clarification' using the review page's own field labels (Purpose … Equipment); 'Message to the organiser'; button 'Send request'; messages 'Choose at least one item that needs clarification.' and 'Write a message for the organiser.'; after sending, 'Clarification requested' and an 'Open clarification' box; a failure without a reason shows 'Could not send your request. Please try again.'

RESOLVED 2026-10-19: On the event page the open clarification is an amber banner titled 'Clarification requested' with the items, the message and 'Asked by <coordinator> on <date, time>' - not the Discussion tab (S-09), which stays hidden until SPM-26.

RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Only one clarification may be open on an event at a time; the option is hidden while one is open. A second request sent anyway is refused with 'This event already has an open clarification.' - not reachable from the UI, so covered by unit test only.
RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Approve and Reject stay available while a clarification is open (the story does not block them).

RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Who may see the open clarification - the organisers of the event's client and the assigned coordinator only. Other staff roles (Ops Manager, Venue Staff, Technical Support, Safety Officer) are covered by unit tests, not manual cases, since the story does not name them.

RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Only the assigned coordinator may request clarification, and only while the event is Under review - enforced by the server (unit tests). In the app, the 'Review request' page already refuses anyone else and redirects away from a decided event (SPM-28), so no extra manual case.
RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Out of scope - the organiser responding (SPM-26) and any notification (SPM-53). No case for either.

RESOLVED 2026-10-19: Test data. scripts/seed-spm29.ts (`npm run fixtures:spm29`) is written with the code, since the clarification's items need the new `fields` column. It recreates only these events, organiser Rachel Ng (Meridian Financial Group), coordinator Daniel Tan, dated April 2028: 'SPM29 Meridian Clarity Summit' (Under review, no clarification) and 'SPM29 Meridian Open Question Forum' (Under review, an open clarification by Daniel Tan on 12 Oct 2026, 10:00 about Purpose and When: 'Is this a dinner or a conference? Which day do you need?'). The same events go at the end of prisma/seed.ts. TC02 changes data, so its precondition says to run the script before and after.
